e2.title: Import E2 project
e2.description: Safely imports an EUD Editor 2 E2S or E2P project into a new working folder.
e2.note: The original E2S/E2P and its linked files aren't changed. Unsupported active features aren't skipped; you'll be told why.
e2.step1Desc: Choose the E2S or E2P file to import.
e2.step2Desc: Choose a new, empty folder. The imported project is created there.
e2.step3Desc: If the original map or resources can't be found, link them again yourself.
e2.linksOk: Linked files checked. You can start the import.
e2.linksPending: Choose a file and a working folder to check the links.

e3s.incomplete: The import didn't finish. The project wasn't activated.
e3s.commandFailed: Couldn't run the import. Check the error details, reopen the app, and try again.
e3s.title: Import E3S project
e3s.description: Imports a .e3s project you worked on in EUD Editor 3. Afterwards you can edit and build here without running EUD Editor 3.
e3s.noteStrong: The original E3S and map files aren't changed.
e3s.note1: It's imported as a separate project into a new empty folder. Later work is saved there and isn't applied to the original E3S.
e3s.note2Before: Durable data such as approved documents, project memory and the wiki is saved in the new project's
e3s.note2After: . Conversations and running work stay in this PC's AppData and aren't moved. The original harness is preserved.
e3s.note3: Projects whose MainFile is CUI epScript are supported. Projects that include unsupported formats such as GUI or RawText can't be imported.
e3s.step1Desc: Choose the project's .e3s file. Keep the original SCX/SCM it refers to in the same folder.
e3s.step2Desc: Create a new folder in the picker and choose that empty folder. The imported project and later work are saved there.
e3s.step3Review: Review the paths and reasons for the optional items that couldn't be imported, then decide whether to import the remaining healthy data.
e3s.step3Idle: When the import starts, any optionally linked harness data is checked safely.
e3s.reviewLabel: Review items that couldn't be imported
e3s.reviewList: Extra items that couldn't be imported
e3s.reviewNote: Only the reviewed items are left out of the new project. The remaining readable data is imported, and the original isn't changed.
e3s.reviewIdle: If optional items can't be imported, you can review their paths and reasons here and agree to continue.
